newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bomb thrown at Turk newspaper headquarters.
newsitem.headline: Bomb thrown at Turk newspaper headquarters.

text.p: Unknown assailants threw a bomb at the headquarters of a Turkish newspaper in Istanbul on Sunday but the attack hurt no one and caused only minor damage, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
One man lobbed a bomb over the fence of the secularist Hurriyet mass-circulation daily in the early hours of Sunday, before escaping in a car with an accomplice, the agency said.
A young man with apparent Islamist leanings entered the same building last month overpowering a guard and shooting a cleaner in the leg before surrendering to police.
Several other media organisations have suffered similar minor attacks in recent months.

Turkish journalists last month staged a protest against the attacks and pointed a finger at anti-media statements by the Islamist-led government of Tansu Ciller and Necmettin Erbakan, who resigned last week.
Kurdish, Islamist and hard-left groups have carried out attacks on newspapers and media groups in the past.
